title: CARRUSEL 4 Thinking about stem cell therapy?
caption:
Thinking about stem cell therapy in Cancun? Here's what international patients should know before traveling ✈️

The whole process is designed so you know exactly what to expect before your trip. It looks like this 🧬

✅ Step 1: Schedule a virtual consultation. We review your condition, symptoms and medical history
✅ Step 2: If additional studies are needed, we'll let you know before you travel
✅ Step 3: Our medical team creates a personalized regenerative medicine plan based on your goals
✅ Step 4: Travel to Cancun. Many patients combine their treatment with their vacation
✅ Step 5: Receive your treatment at Regeneris Therapy, guided through every step of the process

More than 3,360 patients have trusted Regeneris Therapy in their pursuit of a better quality of life 🤍

➡️📱 Wondering if you're a candidate? Book your free virtual consultation.
